display_name: Pacific Cross Vietnam travel insurance wording (Travel Insurance Policy / Quy tắc bảo hiểm du lịch), English and Vietnamese: general terms, Travel Flex and Annual Travel terms, insuring sections 1A-12, other insurance, definitions and claims procedure

run.method: one agent, one session (resumed 2026-10-07 after a usage-limit pause), no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: The instrument is printed twice, English (src 1-1077) then Vietnamese (src 1079-2208), and states no rule of precedence. Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Each operative rule cites both texts on `-- src:N |` lines generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote. Where the texts give different answers the rule exists twice ('reading the English' / 'reading the Vietnamese') behind a Text version input; the findings are VN-F1 to VN-F27 in NOTES.md section 4. The tag EN≠VI is written 'EN ≠ VI' in the deposit because vnsrc reads the decomposed '≠' as a Vietnamese diacritic.

documents.rendering: ../../source/raw/pacificcross-travel.txt (src:N is line N of this file)
documents.authority: the insurer's own published wording; both language halves treated as the instrument

aids: Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, .aids/law-08-2022-qh15.txt (read for LAW forks only; not encoded)

scope: The whole document. Encoded (184 coverage rows): clauses 1, 4-17; Travel Flex; Annual Travel 1-6; sections 1A, 1B, 2-12 with every proviso, limit and exclusion; other insurance; 21 of the 28 definitions as tests or inputs; the Short Period Rate and Personal Accident tables; Claims Procedure 1-2 (three regulative rules). Inert (37 rows): headings, the preamble, clause 2 (construction), clause 3 (choice of law), the definitions no operative clause uses (Cash, Emergency, Medicines and Drugs, Personal Effects, Specialist) or that only name inputs (Physician, Policy, Public Place), CP 1's 'proof satisfactory to the Company', the version marker. Out of scope: none. Deferred: none. Inputs with no default: everything the Insurance Certificate supplies (plan, product, dates, per-section limits, premiums); a limit the Certificate does not state is refused by name. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F-MONTHS: Calendar months by add months, clamped at month end (31 Aug + 6 months = 28 Feb).
forks.F-START: Cover starts at the later of departure and the first day of the Period of Insurance.
forks.F-C7: Clause 7's '(unless it is Annual Travel Policy)' excepts Annual Travel from the whole clause; AT 3 governs.
forks.F-C14: Clause 14's 180-day maximum does not bind Annual Travel (literal reading recorded as finding F-C14).
forks.F-AGE: 6 weeks to 75 tested on the first day of the Period; the 76 bar on the date of the event.
forks.F-ACCOMP: An unaccompanied child under 7 fails clause 1's conditions precedent.
forks.F-AGE18: 'Children under 18' tested on the date of the Accident or loss.
forks.F-AT3: No refund to a Policyholder who cancels after a claim or without returning the card.
forks.F-AT3N: A cancellation on less than 7 days' notice is refused as not provided for.
forks.F-AT5: '14 days before the scheduled commencement date' is the 14th day before, inclusive.
forks.F-AT6: The day of departure is day 1 of the 90.
forks.F-PRORATA: Pro rata by days of the Period of Insurance.
forks.F-SPR: A month begun counts in the Short Period Rate; 20% + 8 x 10% = 100% closes the table.
forks.F-PEC: Clause 5.1 read through the definition of Pre-Existing Condition.
forks.F-EXCL: 'Excluded Conditions' (1B.4(c), undefined) read as the conditions clause 5 excludes.
forks.F-VIDAY: 1B.4 Vietnamese '/ngày' = each calendar day as an inpatient.
forks.F-CHECKUP: A check-up is not an expense 1A.1(a) names, whatever 1A.2(h) excepts.
forks.F-1A-AFTER: An expense abroad after cover by an insured who could return is refused (1A.2(i) speaks only of one unable to return).
forks.F-LAPTOP: 3.6(c) excludes laptops; 3.3's laptop limit is not reached.
forks.F-3PARTY: 3.2(a) police notice applies to theft, robbery and burglary.
forks.F-SET: Camera body, lenses and accessories are one set however named.
forks.F-FINAL: 4.6 'final destination' = the end of a journey that does not return home.
forks.F-RIOT: The popular-rising qualifier in English 5.3 governs mutiny, riot and civil commotion.
forks.F-DRUGS: 'other than those prescribed' qualifies drugs and solvents, not alcohol.
forks.F-VIAIR: Vietnamese 5.7: an aircraft not validly licensed and of an unrecognized airline.
forks.F-PC: The Public Conveyance list is illustrative.
forks.F-PAROWS: PA table rows that are defined terms are tested against the definitions; 'loss of use' rows taken as claimed.
forks.F-S7P5: 7.5 '(applicable for Annual Travel)' qualifies only the scheduled-commencement limb.
forks.F-S8WIN: The Cancellation Charges window is tested on the date the cause arose.
forks.F-S8P4: 8 proviso 4 '(applicable for Annual Travel)' governs only the 14-day limb.
forks.F-DEDUCT: Section 12 deductible applied before the 500,000,000 maximum.
forks.F-RATABLE: Ratable proportion by limits (Law Art. 49(2) analogy).
forks.F-PLASAP: CP 1 Personal Liability: only the 15-day bound encoded.
forks.F-AT1: AT 1 duty encoded on the Vietnamese; the English grammar reverses it.
forks.F-12REF: Section 12 'reserves the right to refuse' is a power, encoded as when it is open.
forks.F-C17VI: Vietnamese clause 17 silent on a right of action: refused by name.
forks.LAW-CONTRA: Law Art. 24 (unclear terms read for the buyer) may pick between the texts; not resolved.
forks.LAW-SUBRO: Law Arts. 16(4), 38, 54(3) against clause 9 subrogation for health sections; not resolved.
forks.LAW-TERM: Law Art. 26 against AT 3's cancellation at will; not resolved.
forks.LAW-NOTICE: Law Arts. 19(3), 46 on late notice; not resolved.
forks.LAW-CLAIM: Law Art. 30's one year against CP 1 and clause 4; not resolved.
forks.LAW-PAY: Law Art. 31's 15 days fills the silent payment deadline; not encoded.
forks.LAW-FRAUD: Law Art. 22(2) premium return against clauses 7 and 16; not resolved.
forks.LAW-UNDEF: Law Art. 87(2)(b) wants terms defined; finding F-UNDEF.
forks.LAW-EXCL: Law Art. 19(2) explanation of exclusions; a fact of the sale, not encoded.

self_check.vnsrc_gate: vnsrc check: 2478 src: lines, 640 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems (every .l4 and .md except BRIEF.md); the brief's literal command over *.l4 *.md also reads BRIEF.md and reports 4 problems, all in BRIEF.md

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against either text. No independent test pass has been run (the row was briefed as one session with no sub-agents). Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the cited clause before the rule was run; the plan-table values were parsed from the raw text by script.
